Vilanterol has a rapid onset & prolonged duration of action
5mins
Onset of action

Duration of action

Significant bronchodilation as early as 5 minutes after dosing (asthma) and persisting for at least 24 hours. 25mcg VI FEV1 (mean difference from placebo): 5 minutes = 225mL (95% CI: 127-324); 24 hours = 273mL (95% CI: 178-369). VI, vilanterol.
